title: Refund Policy
content: Refund Policy (v1). Customers may request a refund within 14 days of delivery. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refund Policy (v2, effective 2026-03-01). Customers may request a refund within 30 days of delivery. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days. This version replaces version 1.

title: Shipping SLA
content: Shipping SLA. Standard delivery takes 5 business days. Express delivery takes 2 business days. Deliveries later than the SLA qualify for a shipping credit.

title: Escalation Runbook
content: Escalation Runbook. A P1 incident must receive a first response within 15 minutes. Page the on-call engineer through the incident console and open a bridge call.

title: Legacy Escalation Procedure (deprecated)
content: Legacy Escalation Procedure (deprecated). A P1 incident must receive a first response within 60 minutes. Send an email to the operations mailbox.
